rule: IF aceE (K00163) present AND cyoA (K02297) absent AND coxL (K03520) present THEN has uses_O2
grounding_reasons: aceE present: aerobic-lifestyle signal consistent with the rule; cyoA: a pathway gene required absent - the rule covers organisms without it (another enzyme or a lineage), not the pathway itself; coxL present: aerobic-lifestyle signal consistent with the rule
conditions: aceE present: pyruvate dehydrogenase E1: aerobic pyruvate oxidation (anaerobes use O2-sensitive PFOR instead) | cyoA absent: cytochrome bo3 ubiquinol oxidase subunit II: a terminal O2 reductase of aerobic respiration | coxL present: aerobic CO dehydrogenase large subunit
logic: It requires cyoA to be absent, so it covers only the organisms that run this physiology without cyoA — one branch of it, not all. Its lifestyle markers (aceE → aerobic; coxL → aerobic) agree with the aerobic lifestyle the trait requires; it contains no pathway gene, so it reads the lifestyle, not the pathway itself.
breadth: narrower than the trait: 71% of its hits are Actinobacteria, against 27% of all organisms with the trait — it captures mainly that lineage’s version of the trait (4 of 21 phyla)

rule: IF cooS (K00198) present AND cyoA (K02297) absent AND pflA-like (K04070) present THEN lacks uses_O2
grounding_reasons: cooS present: anaerobic-lifestyle signal consistent with the rule; cyoA absent: part of the pathway, but 77% of organisms with the trait also lack it (alternative enzymes), so its absence says little; pflA-like present: anaerobic-lifestyle signal consistent with the rule
conditions: cooS present: anaerobic CO dehydrogenase: oxidises CO / reduces CO2 (Wood-Ljungdahl, carboxydotrophs) | cyoA absent: cytochrome bo3 ubiquinol oxidase subunit II: a terminal O2 reductase of aerobic respiration | pflA-like present: putative pyruvate formate-lyase activating enzyme: PFL is destroyed by O2, so it suggests anaerobic fermentation
logic: The rule fires when pathway gene(s) (cyoA) are missing. Whether that rules the trait out depends on whether another enzyme can do the same job — the measured precision, not the biology alone, says how often it does. Its lifestyle markers (cooS → anaerobic; pflA-like → anaerobic) point away from the aerobic lifestyle the trait requires.
breadth: as broad as the trait: 8 of 24 phyla; Firmicutes makes up 52% of hits and 38% of all organisms without the trait — the rule follows the trait’s own distribution
